name: MSRC
full_name: Magnetically steerable robotic catheter with integrated magnetic localisation
group: Lei Zhou and Farshid Alambeigi (both UT Austin in mohanraj2022; Zhou at Univ. Wisconsin-Madison in wu2023)
versions: 2022 BioRob: kirigami heat-shrink catheter, Helmholtz pair and friction-drive feeder, manual knobs (mohanraj2022_kirigami, full) -> 2023 RA-L: integrated magnetic localisation (wu2023_integrated)
target_anatomy: peripheral arterial disease (lower-limb phantoms: Y 20 deg, S-shaped, 30 deg branch)
devices_driven: Cook G11430 catheter with 40 mm flexure-patterned heat-shrink distal end (3.2 mm pre-shrink OD), tip stack of N52 ring magnets 3 mm OD / 1.6 mm ID / 6 mm
n_dof_detail: 2 (insertion and planar steering; mohanraj2022 Sec. I, II-B); hardware: Helmholtz pair (220 mm diameter, 120 turns, up to 11 A) steering; friction-drive feeder on stepper
translation_detail: magnetic (steering) + friction-drive feeder (drive wheel with a thick urethane layer, NEMA 17 stepper, spring preload; mohanraj2022 Sec. II-C, III-A)
force_sensing: 16 three-axis magnetoresistive sensors (QMC5883L) locate the tip
imaging_compat: fluoroscopy only at bifurcations; digital microscope in bench tests
validation_detail: three 3D-printed phantoms; catheter navigates under steering plus localisation; trial counts N.R.
key_numbers: mean position estimate error 0.95 mm after calibration; latency 400 ms mohanraj2022: 25 mT steering field at 13 A (power-supply limit); maximum tip deflection 12 mm; calculated pushing force 8 N (Sec. III-A, IV); one navigation through a 25 deg bifurcation of a leg phantom in 20 s (Sec. III-B, Fig. 9).
sim_model: mohanraj2022: analytical Helmholtz-field and dipole-torque model, Ansys Maxwell 3D finite elements for field and torque, SolidWorks finite elements for the flexure bending; tip displacement FE vs experiment RMSE 0.575 and 0.328 mm (Sec. II, IV, Figs. 4, 6)
